identities.amp_and_workers: chosen by the plan step-B rule and logged before step C

metric: common-four balanced accuracy of the selected checkpoint; five/six probabilities summed into Class VIII

pmm_published.use: descriptive context only; not a matched comparison; no interval for the difference

rules.failed_runs: rerun once unchanged; second failure: step D not passing, steps C/E stop for diagnosis
rules.improvement_check: final recipe vs baseline four_class on folds 1-4 (t df 3); fold 0 reported as the development fold; an improvement is claimed only when both lower bounds on folds 1-4 are above zero; five-fold results of improved recipes are development-validation
rules.neutral_target: per family five-vs-four and six-vs-four on folds 0-4; tie keeps four_class; both better: larger mean gain, within tie_band five_class (a selection convention, not evidence that five beats six)
rules.outcome: better: bootstrap and t lower bounds > 0; worse: both upper bounds < 0; else no clear difference
rules.recall_gates: no missing/zero common-four mean recall; no common-four class mean recall drop > recall_drop_limit; five/six: no zero native mean recall
rules.screen: fold 0, seeds 42 and 43: mean delta >= screen_min_mean_delta, delta > 0 both seeds, no common-four mean recall change < screen_min_recall_change
rules.stage6: control kept unless an eligible, interval-supported candidate is best by mean common-four BA; tie-breakers per pmm_v3_assessment.stage6_tie_key; a positive mean gain on folds 1-4 permits consideration only and is not an improvement claim
